title: Output of jobs-bulk-feed
description: Results of jobs-bulk-feed: the jobs dataset (table view and all fields) and the run summary.

resultsDatasetUrl.title: Jobs
resultsDatasetUrl.description: Every job in the nightly index matching the filters (or only jobs new since the last run with sinceLastRun), one row per job (table columns only; allFieldsDatasetUrl has every field).

allFieldsDatasetUrl.title: Jobs (all fields)
allFieldsDatasetUrl.description: Same rows with every field of the dataset schema, as JSON

runSummary.title: Run summary
runSummary.description: Run summary (key-value record RUN_SUMMARY): rows written, charged events, errors, failure class, duration and finish time
